rows.quote: Specifically, these data were represented by the following FinnGen identifiers: vitamin D deficiency (finn-b-E4_VIT_D_DEF), cancer (finn-b-C3_CANCER), and diabetes (finn-b-E4_DIABETES).
rows.coder_note: Step 3 (rules B, C4 third case): the sentence gives the OpenGWAS accessions finn-b-E4_VIT_D_DEF, finn-b-C3_CANCER and finn-b-E4_DIABETES; no dictionary row lists the prefix 'finn-b', a range or these identifiers (the FinnGen rows list only release names such as finngen_R5), and no release number, sample size or citation is given, so the accession is not mapped to the closest release.

rows.quote: These GWAS data can also be retrieved from the IEU Open GWAS repository, under accession code ieu-b-4980, which covers a population of 486,484 participants, including 11,643 sepsis cases.
rows.coder_note: Step 3 (rules B, C4 third case): the sentence gives the OpenGWAS accession ieu-b-4980 for the UK Biobank sepsis GWAS of the preceding sentence; no dictionary row lists the prefix 'ieu-b' (the MRC-IEU row lists ukb-b and ukb-d only), a range or this identifier. Citation 14 (Bycroft 2018) is a general cohort description and the source of no dictionary row.

rows.quote: The data used in this study come from the plasma protein pQTL data of the deCODE database version 2021,4 which describes a GWAS study of 35,559 Europeans that measured plasma protein levels using 4907 aptamers; (the pQTL instrumental variables included in the analysis are provided in the appendix pQTL_drug_exposure.txt; 10.5281/zenodo.17283362).
rows.coder_note: Step 2 (exact N with platform and year): 'deCODE database version 2021', 35,559 participants and 4907 aptamers match exactly one row (the Eldjarn 2023 row has 35,892). Step 1 was considered and not applied: two earlier sentences of the passage describe 'DECODE' as profiling 54,219 UK Biobank participants for 2923 proteins, but 54,219 equals no row's sample size and so identifies no other row (rule H). Citation 4 (Monard 2023) is the source of no dictionary row and is not used.
